Class RegionManifest

java.lang.Object
org.roux.session.RegionManifest
public final class RegionManifest extends Object
The RegionManifest is the 112-byte file named manifest.bin. The file sits beside pages.bin. The record stores the page size, the page count, and the hot page id. The record stores the hot used bytes, the next message id, and the last write time. The record stores the creation time, the page-header version, the region id, and the owner. The magic bytes are R, X, M, and 1. The meta version is 1. The checksum covers bytes 0 through 103. A close that keeps files writes this record and leaves the directory. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#RegionManifest roux-v1.md

    • read

      public static RegionManifest read(Path dir) throws IOException
      The method reads manifest.bin. A missing file returns null. A file shorter than 112 bytes throws IOException with manifest too short. A bad magic throws IOException with manifest magic. A meta version other than 1 throws IOException. A checksum mismatch throws IOException with manifest crc. The owner is the UTF-8 text up to the first zero byte, in a 32-byte field.
      Parameters:
      dir - The directory is the region directory.
      Returns:
      The manifest is the parsed record, or null when the file is missing.
      Throws:
      IOException - The file is present and cannot be parsed.

    • write

      public static void write(Path dir, RegionManifest m) throws IOException
      The method writes manifest.bin. The directory is created when it is absent. The bytes go to manifest.bin.tmp, the channel is forced, and the temp file replaces the destination. A failed atomic move deletes the destination and moves the temp file again. An owner longer than 32 bytes is cut to 32 bytes. A null region id is written as a zero UUID. A write that returns a negative count throws IOException with manifest write EOF.
      Parameters:
      dir - The directory is the region directory.
      m - The manifest is the record to write.
      Throws:
      IOException - The write or the move failed.
